AFG_5z.method: Zones of the EPM model itself (data_casa_2020): one zone per modelled node, no clustering.
AFG_5z.boundaries: Boundaries are the model's zone polygons (zones_zcmap.geojson), as used in the dispatch.
AFG_5z.limits: Corridor ratings are the model's own pTransferLimit for 2025, not an estimate; both values are shown when the two directions differ.
